none.description:
{Rune of Control}

Places the Rune of Control upon an allied unit, imbuing them with a dispelling strike that purges all postive spells from attacked enemies. The affected unit will also drain 4 Spell Points from the enemy hero per turn.

basic.description:
{Basic Rune of Control}

Places the Rune of Control upon an allied unit, imbuing them with a dispelling strike that purges all postive spells from attacked enemies. The affected unit will also drain 4 Spell Points from the enemy hero per turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Rune of Control}

Places the Rune of Control upon an allied unit and any allied units adjacent to the target, imbuing them with a dispelling strike that purges all postive spells from attacked enemies. Affected units will also drain 5 Spell Points from the enemy hero per turn.

expert.description:
{Expert Rune of Control}

Places the Rune of Control upon an allied unit and any allied units within 2 hexes of the target, imbuing them with a dispelling strike that purges all postive spells from attacked enemies. Affected units will also drain 6 Spell Points from the enemy hero per turn.
